systems.name: text-reasoning
systems.why: To write the one plain sentence on why each story matters.
systems.called_for: one plain sentence on why it matters

kind.why: One job a harness runs, with the reading and filtering in a script and one model call per story's sentence.

cost.limit: 1 USD per day on the model
cost.why: The statement sets a spending ceiling of 1 USD per day.

speed.why: It reads at most 100 stories and writes a few sentences.

data.why: It reads nothing private and keeps nothing between jobs.

trust.limit: Reads only; never posts, votes or comments
trust.why: The statement refuses posting, voting and commenting.

egress.why: To read the current top stories and each story's details.

formats.convention: A heading for the topic, then one item per story: title as a link, points, one sentence.

decisions.decided: Read the official Hacker News API and nothing else
decisions.why: The statement refuses writing about stories it did not read from Hacker News.
decisions.follows: Every story in a digest comes from an API answer.
